name: graycode
description: GrayCode is a local-first AI workspace with a standalone desktop app, coding tools, bots, and extensible agents.

scripts.build:desktop: node scripts/build-desktop.mjs && npm --workspace @graycode/client run build && npm --prefix frontend run build:platform && node scripts/renderer-budget.mjs
scripts.package:desktop: npm run license:check && npm run package:source && npm run build:desktop && node scripts/package-desktop.mjs
scripts.typecheck:platform: tsc -p packages/core/tsconfig.json && tsc -p apps/server/tsconfig.json && tsc -p packages/core/tests/tsconfig.json
scripts.typecheck:all: npm run typecheck:platform && tsc -p ./ --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json --noEmit && npm run typecheck:desktop && npm --prefix frontend run typecheck
scripts.test:fast-tavern-ts: npm --prefix fast-tavern-main/npm-fast-tavern ci && npm --prefix fast-tavern-main/npm-fast-tavern test
scripts.ci: npm run typecheck:all && npm run test:all && npm run test:platform && npm run test:fast-tavern-ts && npm run test:fast-tavern-py && npm run i18n:check
scripts.build:desktop:trial: node scripts/build-desktop.mjs --package-only && npm --workspace @graycode/client run build:trial && npm --prefix frontend run build:platform:trial

author: Komeiji-Shiki
